outcome: Early resumption of postpartum sexual intercourse
cohort: 330 married postpartum women who visited public hospitals of Jimma zone, Southwest Ethiopia, for child immunization services
finding: Early resumption of postpartum sexual intercourse was significantly associated with low income, monogamous marriage, practicing sexual intercourse during pregnancy, cesarean delivery, and use of contraceptives.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with early resumption of postpartum sexual intercourse.
